announcements_text_length.name: announcements_text_length
announcements_text_length.value: char_length("announcements"."title") between 1 and 60 and char_length("announcements"."body") between 1 and 500

message_attachments_attached.name: message_attachments_attached
message_attachments_attached.value: "message_attachments"."message_id" IS NULL OR ("message_attachments"."position" IS NOT NULL AND "message_attachments"."uploaded_at" IS NOT NULL)

message_attachments_image_size.name: message_attachments_image_size
message_attachments_image_size.value: ("message_attachments"."kind" = 'image' AND "message_attachments"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "message_attachments"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "message_attachments"."width" >= 1 AND "message_attachments"."height" >= 1) OR ("message_attachments"."kind" = 'file' AND "message_attachments"."width" IS NULL AND "message_attachments"."height" IS NULL)

bookings_during_valid.name: bookings_during_valid
bookings_during_valid.value: NOT isempty("bookings"."during") AND NOT lower_inf("bookings"."during") AND NOT upper_inf("bookings"."during") AND lower_inc("bookings"."during") AND NOT upper_inc("bookings"."during")

bookings_cancel_kind_consistent.name: bookings_cancel_kind_consistent
bookings_cancel_kind_consistent.value: ("bookings"."cancel_kind" IS NULL OR "bookings"."status" = 'cancelled') AND (("bookings"."cancel_kind" IS NULL) = ("bookings"."cancel_reason" IS NULL))

bookings_cancel_reason_length.name: bookings_cancel_reason_length
bookings_cancel_reason_length.value: "bookings"."cancel_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("bookings"."cancel_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

space_blocks_during_valid.name: space_blocks_during_valid
space_blocks_during_valid.value: NOT isempty("space_blocks"."during") AND NOT lower_inf("space_blocks"."during") AND NOT upper_inf("space_blocks"."during") AND lower_inc("space_blocks"."during") AND NOT upper_inc("space_blocks"."during")

branches_cover_photo_alt_length.name: branches_cover_photo_alt_length
branches_cover_photo_alt_length.value: "branches"."cover_photo_alt" is null or char_length("branches"."cover_photo_alt") between 1 and 120

chat_room_members_requested.name: chat_room_members_requested
chat_room_members_requested.value: "chat_room_members"."status" NOT IN ('requested', 'declined') OR "chat_room_members"."requested_at" IS NOT NULL

chat_rooms_voice_capacity.name: chat_rooms_voice_capacity
chat_rooms_voice_capacity.value: ("chat_rooms"."kind" = 'voice' AND "chat_rooms"."voice_capacity" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_rooms"."voice_capacity" BETWEEN 2 AND 25) OR ("chat_rooms"."kind" <> 'voice' AND "chat_rooms"."voice_capacity" IS NULL)

chat_rooms_kind_ref.name: chat_rooms_kind_ref
chat_rooms_kind_ref.value: ("chat_rooms"."kind" IN ('text', 'voice') AND "chat_rooms"."space_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_rooms"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_rooms"."dm_low_user_id" IS NULL AND "chat_rooms"."dm_high_user_id" IS NULL AND "chat_rooms"."booking_id" IS NULL) OR ("chat_rooms"."kind" = 'dm' AND "chat_rooms"."dm_low_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_rooms"."dm_high_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_rooms"."dm_low_user_id" < "chat_rooms"."dm_high_user_id" AND "chat_rooms"."space_id" IS NULL AND "chat_rooms"."name" IS NULL AND "chat_rooms"."booking_id" IS NULL) OR ("chat_rooms"."kind" = 'group_dm' AND "chat_rooms"."space_id" IS NULL AND "chat_rooms"."dm_low_user_id" IS NULL AND "chat_rooms"."dm_high_user_id" IS NULL AND "chat_rooms"."booking_id" IS NULL) OR ("chat_rooms"."kind" = 'meeting' AND "chat_rooms"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_rooms"."space_id" IS NULL AND "chat_rooms"."name" IS NULL AND "chat_rooms"."dm_low_user_id" IS NULL AND "chat_rooms"."dm_high_user_id" IS NULL)

chat_rooms_name_length.name: chat_rooms_name_length
chat_rooms_name_length.value: ("chat_rooms"."name" IS NULL OR char_length("chat_rooms"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 30) AND ("chat_rooms"."topic" IS NULL OR char_length("chat_rooms"."topic") <= 200)

chat_spaces_kind_ref.name: chat_spaces_kind_ref
chat_spaces_kind_ref.value: ("chat_spaces"."kind" = 'team' AND "chat_spaces"."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_spaces"."branch_id" IS NULL AND "chat_spaces"."name" IS NULL) OR ("chat_spaces"."kind" = 'branch' AND "chat_spaces"."branch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_spaces"."team_id" IS NULL AND "chat_spaces"."name" IS NULL) OR ("chat_spaces"."kind" = 'community' AND "chat_spaces"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_spaces"."created_by" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_spaces"."team_id" IS NULL AND "chat_spaces"."branch_id" IS NULL)

messages_author_kind.name: messages_author_kind
messages_author_kind.value: ("messages"."kind" = 'system' AND "messages"."author_id" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."kind" = 'text' AND "messages"."author_id" IS NOT NULL)

messages_body_length.name: messages_body_length
messages_body_length.value: ("messages"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND (("messages"."kind" = 'text' AND char_length("messages"."body") BETWEEN 0 AND 4000) OR ("messages"."kind" = 'system' AND char_length("messages"."body") BETWEEN 1 AND 4000))) OR ("messages"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."body" = '')

messages_system_data.name: messages_system_data
messages_system_data.value: ("messages"."kind" = 'system' AND "messages"."system_data" IS NOT NULL) OR ("messages"."kind" = 'text' AND "messages"."system_data" IS NULL)

reports_open_message_idx.name: reports_open_message_idx
reports_open_message_idx.where: "reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "reports"."message_id" IS NOT NULL

reports_resolution_consistent.name: reports_resolution_consistent
reports_resolution_consistent.value: ("reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL) = ("reports"."resolved_by" IS NULL) AND ("reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL) = ("reports"."resolution" IS NULL)

team_invites_one_pending.name: team_invites_one_pending
team_invites_one_pending.where: "team_invites"."email" is not null and "team_invites"."accepted_at" is null and "team_invites"."declined_at" is null and "team_invites"."revoked_at" is null
